id./param/scenario/cs/a_110_cs_080.pack|cs_: "It's still raining outside. Your clothes are wet, so let's warm up.
"I'm glad I could save you. I never wanted to feel the way I did that day ever again...
"Lady Eleanor became a decoy to save you and the Heliodor princess... Master Rab must have told you that.
"Yes... I am the daughter of King Carnelian, whose life Lady Eleanor saved...
"Sixteen years ago, Lady Eleanor, holding you, led me out of Dundrasil Castle. But we were cornered by a pack of monsters...
"Lady Eleanor entrusted you to me and became a decoy so I could flee. And yet...!
"Found by the monsters, I was young and powerless, fell into a river while fleeing... and let go of you...!
"I've thought many times that it should have been you Master Rab rescued afterward, not me...
"After we were separated, I went with Master Rab to my homeland of Heliodor. I meant to ask Father for help.
"But Father had decided I was dead... and spread word that the Luminary killed me. As if to hide the truth from the people.
"...Master Rab said there must be someone behind Father, whispering to him.
"To find out who is using Father and reveal the truth, Master Rab and I set out on a journey.
"But I never expected Hendrik to come. If we're attacked again, I don't know if we could escape next time...
"The rain seems to have stopped. For now, let's return to Dundrasil Castle.
